本产品冻结的可执行约定，不代表官方认证或所有地区统一规则。旧版比赛沿用创建时的规: These are this game’s fixed house rules, not an official standard for every region. Older matches retain the rules they were created with.
两副共 108 张，每人 27 张。你在下方，与上方的青禾一队。行动顺序为你 →: Two decks make 108 cards, with 27 per player. You sit at the bottom, partnered with Qinghe opposite you. Turns run from you to Nanshan on the right, Qinghe at the top, then Songfeng on the left. The first lead is random. Everyone’s remaining card count is public.
头游所在队伍获胜。任一队两人出完即结算：同队占前两名为双上，对方记双下；前两名分: The team with the first finisher wins the deal. Play ends when both teammates finish: first and second is a one-two finish, and the other team shares the bottom places. If the first two finishers are on different teams, play continues until the third finishes; the remaining player is last.
经典升级：两队各记级数，一副共用级牌: Classic matches: separate team levels, one shared level rank
双方各从 2 开始。头游的对家为二游、三游、末游时，胜方从自己的原有级数分别升: Both teams start at 2. If the first finisher’s partner places second, third or last, the winning team advances 3, 2 or 1 levels from its own current level. The other team stays put. Levels are capped at A. The next deal uses the previous winner’s new level rank for all four players, fixed until the deal ends.
例如我方双上从 2 升到 5，对方仍为 2，下一副打 5。若对方接着取得头游＋三: For example, a one-two finish takes your team from 2 to 5 while the other team stays at 2; the next deal is played at 5. If the other team then finishes first and third, it advances from its own 2 to 4. Your team stays at 5, and the next deal is played at 4.
过 A 必须同时满足：该队开副前已是 A、本副共同级牌为 A、该队取得头游且对家: To clear A, a team must already be at A before the deal, the shared level rank must be A, and that team must finish first with its partner second or third. Merely reaching A does not win the match. First and last at A leaves the team at A. A team already at A that wins a deal played at a lower rank earns a chance to play at A next. When both teams are at A, either can clear it. There is no reset to 2 after three failed attempts.
单贡、双贡与先手: Single tribute, double tribute and the lead
首副不进贡，随机先手。从第二副开始，普通单贡由上副末游向头游贡一张最大非逢人配牌: There is no tribute in the first deal, and the lead is random. From the second deal, the previous last finisher gives their highest non-wild card to the first finisher, who returns a card along the same route, even if both are teammates. The last finisher then leads. After a one-two finish, both losing players give tribute: the higher card goes to first place, the lower to second. The giver to first place leads. The two losing players are not assigned artificial third and fourth places.
本场为旧版比赛，等贡沿用旧版座位映射，还牌候选和交换时机沿用创建时的 guan-: This is a legacy match. Equal-tribute seat mapping, return candidates and exchange timing follow the original guan-match-v1 rules. The rules below apply to newly created classic matches.
两张贡牌等大时，固定由上一副头游的上家向头游进贡，另一位向二游进贡。座位为你 0: When the tribute cards tie, the player immediately before the previous first finisher gives to first place; the other gives to second. Seats are you 0, right 1, opposite 2 and left 3. If seats 0 and 2 finished first and second, the transfers are 3 → 0 and 1 → 2, and seat 3 leads. Returns follow each transfer in reverse.
贡牌按新副的单张大小，从原始 27 张中选最大的非逢人配实体；红心级牌排除，其他: Choose the highest non-wild physical card from the new deal’s original 27 cards, using that deal’s single-card ranking. Heart level cards are excluded; level cards of other suits are eligible. Suits do not break ties, so any equally ranked card may be chosen.
还贡范围与兜底: Return cards and the fallback rule
旧版优先还 10 及以下的非级普通牌；没有时按旧版“最小非逢人配”候选执行。旧档: Legacy matches prefer ordinary non-level cards of rank 10 or lower, then use the old lowest non-wild fallback. Old saves never silently adopt the new rules.
从本次原始 27 张选一张自然点数 2–10 的非级牌。所有花色的本副级牌、大小: Choose an ordinary card of natural rank 2–10 from the original 27. All level cards and both jokers are excluded; A is not treated as 1. You cannot return the tribute card you just received.
没有正常候选时，排除大小王与全部本副级牌，按自然点数还最小的普通牌；同点实体都可: If there are no normal candidates, exclude all jokers and level cards, then return the lowest remaining natural rank. Any tied physical card is eligible. For example, at level 7, if you have no eligible 2–6 or 8–10 and J is the lowest eligible rank, you may return J. Human players must select and confirm their own return.
双贡必须双方确认后才公开贡牌与配对；所有还牌确认后一次交换，并公开还牌。中途每人: In double tribute, both givers must confirm before tribute cards and pairings become public. All returns are exchanged together after every player confirms. Everyone keeps their original 27 cards while choosing and has 27 after the exchange. Normal plays are disabled during the exchange.
单贡只检查应进贡的末游本人：独自持有两张真实大王才抗贡。双贡检查两位贡方合计的两: For single tribute, the giver alone must hold both real big jokers to resist. For double tribute, the two givers must collectively hold both real big jokers, either together or one each. Wild cards cannot substitute for jokers.
抗贡在选贡之前自动判断，成立就取消本副全部进贡和还贡，由上副头游先出。只公开两张: Resistance is checked automatically before tribute selection. If it applies, all tribute and returns are cancelled and the previous first finisher leads. Only the two big jokers and their holders are revealed. Resistance cannot be predicted before the next deal is actually dealt.
单张与同点数牌型大小：大王 ＞ 小王 ＞ 级牌 ＞ A ＞ K…2。两张红心级牌: Singles and same-rank groups rank: big joker > small joker > level rank > A > K … 2. The two heart level cards are wild: they may substitute for any ordinary rank and suit, but never a joker. Alone, or as a pair of wild cards, they count as level cards.
有多种解释时可在操作区选择；替代映射在出牌前后都可见。连续牌型中，级牌仍按自然点: If a selection has several legal interpretations, choose one in the action area. Wild-card substitutions are shown before and after play. In sequences, level cards retain their natural rank.
单张、对子、三张、三带二（只比较三张）、恰好五张的顺子、恰好三组的三连对、恰好两: Single, pair, triple, full house (compare the triple only), a straight of exactly five cards, exactly three consecutive pairs, or exactly two consecutive triples. A reply must have the same type and card count and be strictly higher. Equal rank does not beat a play.
两个真实小王或两个真实大王可作对子；大小王各一张不是对子。没有三带一、四带二、飞: Two real small jokers or two real big jokers may form a pair. One of each cannot. There are no triples with a single attachment, four-with-two, winged airplanes or variable-length pair sequences.
顺子从 A2345 到 10JQKA；三连对从 AA2233 到 QQKKAA；: Straights range from A2345 to 10JQKA; consecutive pairs from AA2233 to QQKKAA; consecutive triples from AAA222 to KKKAAA. A may be low or high but cannot wrap around. JQKA2 and KKAA22 are illegal. Jokers cannot appear in sequences.
4 张炸弹 ＜ 5 张炸弹 ＜ 同花顺 ＜ 6 张 ＜ 7 张 ＜ 8 张 ＜: 4-card bomb < 5-card bomb < straight flush < 6-, 7-, 8-, 9-, 10-card bombs < four jokers.
同张数炸弹比点数。同花顺恰好五张有效同花连续牌，只比较连续大小、不比较花色。天然: Bombs of equal size compare rank. A straight flush is exactly five consecutive cards of one effective suit; only sequence rank matters, not suit. A natural straight flush cannot be downgraded to an ordinary straight. The four-joker bomb requires both real big and both real small jokers. Wild cards can extend ordinary bombs but cannot be counted twice; a level-rank bomb has at most eight cards.
有待压牌时可以主动不出；之后有人再出牌，轮转回来仍可跟牌。所有其他仍参与的人都放: You may pass when responding to a play. If someone subsequently plays, you may respond when your turn returns. The trick ends when every other active player has declined to beat the current play.
最后出牌者还有手牌，由其领出；已出完则由仍有牌的对家接风。出完后其他人仍有合法跟: The last player to make a play leads again if they still hold cards. Otherwise their partner inherits the lead if still active. Opponents retain the chance to respond after a player finishes; the lead does not immediately jump to their partner. You cannot pass when leading a new trick.
单击选牌，按住鼠标划过可连续选牌；从已选牌开始划则连续取消。松开后再点出牌。双击: Click to select cards, or drag across them to select several. Start on a selected card to deselect as you drag. Release, then choose Play. Double-click selects all cards of the same original rank. Organizing preserves physical card selection. DanLM hints only highlight a suggestion and never play automatically. Clear selection or click empty hand space to clear all cards. With the hand focused: H requests a DanLM hint, P passes, Esc clears and Enter plays. Computers pause while settings are open or the window is in the background.
有效操作后自动保存当前比赛与升级进度。经典升级提供整场回放，可选副、查看贡还牌与: Accepted actions automatically save the current game and match progress. Classic replays let you choose a deal and inspect exchanges and level changes. Practice has separate saves and replays. All hands are visible only after a deal ends; live play shows only your own. Each computer receives only its own cards and public information.
